title: Animal Updates
text:
[Los Angeles Zoo, 5333 Zoo Drive, in Griffith Park]
FOR INFORMATION ONLY

  CITY OF LOS ANGELES
  LOS ANGELES ZOO

DATE:  September 15, 2026

TO:  BOARD OF ZOO COMMISSIONERS

FROM:  DENISE M. VERRET, Zoo Director

SUBJECT:  LOS ANGELES ZOO ANIMAL UPDATES REPORT

The following is a list of animal transfers that have been completed. Funds from sales
will be deposited into the City’s Animal Purchases and Sales account. All receiving
institutions are accredited by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA) unless
otherwise noted. Animal transfers support the Zoo’s commitment to sustainable
population management through participation in AZA Species Survival Plan (SSP)
Program recommendations, animal welfare and conservation efforts. Transfers reflect
loans, purchases, sales and donations and include animals that are owned by the Los
Angeles Zoo, but reside in the care of other AZA-accredited or approved institutions.

OUTGOING

Donation (ownership only) to Louisville Zoological Garden in Kentucky of 1.0 North
Sulawesi babirusa. This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to Omaha Henry Doorly Zoo in Nebraska of 2.0 Black howler
monkey. This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to Omaha Henry Doorly Zoo in Nebraska of 1.1.2 Catalina
Island rattlesnake. This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to Houston Zoo in Texas of 2.0 Catalina Island rattlesnake.
This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to St. Augustine Alligator Farm in Florida of 0.1 Chinese
Alligator. This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to Lincoln Children’s Zoo in Omaha, Nebraska of 1.0 Eastern
black-and-white colobus. This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to Detroit Zoo in Royal Oak, Michigan of 2.2 Greater flamingo.
This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to Albuquerque Biological Park in New Mexico of 0.1 Komodo
dragon. This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Page 2 – Animal Updates Report

Donation (ownership only) to Zoo Boise in Idaho of 0.1 Maned wolf. This transfer
eliminated an unnecessary loan.

Donation (ownership only) to Steinhart Aquarium in San Francisco, CA of 2.0 Rio Fuerte
beaded lizard. This transfer eliminated an unnecessary loan.

INCOMING
None
